Feedback.title: Feedback
Feedback.description: User-submitted feedback, bug report, or feature suggestion from the Setup page.

category.description: Type of feedback submitted by the user.

senderName.description: Optional name or clinic role provided by the sender.

status.description: Creator triage status for the feedback item.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp recorded at submission time.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: Stores user feedback and suggestions. Anyone may submit a validated new entry; only the verified creator may read, triage, or delete entries.
